dataset_spec.name: uci_cervical
dataset_spec.description: UCI Cervical Cancer Risk Factors (Hospital Universitario de Caracas; 858 women). 29 predictors: sexual and reproductive history, smoking, contraception, sexually transmitted infections, and the three other screening tests (Hinselmann, Schiller, cytology). Binary cervical biopsy result.
dataset_spec.setting: Woman attending a gynaecology clinic in Caracas for cervical cancer screening. The observations are her self-reported sexual and reproductive history, smoking, hormonal contraception and intrauterine device use, history of sexually transmitted infections, and the results of the Hinselmann (acetic acid) colposcopy test, the Schiller (iodine) test and cervical cytology.
